240180402.text: We had the same line of thought! A bouquet of fragrant flowers will improve her mood for sure.

240180406.text: I... can't leave at the moment. If she comes back around and finds me missing, I can forget about talking to her for the next two weeks.

240180501.text: Why don't we try sending perfume?

240180514.text: Oh boy, this guy's silly smile is back again...

240180508.text: Anyway, who even sells perfume on Erinnyes? I mean... Anyway, I'm counting on you, Traveler!

240180602.text: Of course, my thoughts precisely! I was thinking of getting a new tank of fish fry for Linorea myself!

240180603.text: Since job-related issues are troubling her, our encouragement should follow that same angle.

240180604.text: Please make a trip to the Court of Fontaine on my behalf. The man you're looking for is named Batasso, Linorea's colleague. He's certain to have some good fish fry on him.

240180605.text: How are you so sure? What if he doesn't have any?

240180606.text: I... In truth, I've been asking this gentleman to teach me how to rear fish, and I've bought lots of high-quality fry from him as well... Of course, Linorea knows nothing about this.

240180607.text: Ah, yes, let me mark this location for you. Batasso tends to show up there.

240180610.text: Well, she is just so lovable...

240180611.text: #Let's go get the fry, {NICKNAME}. He can smile here all he wants!

240182002.text: Sorry, Semaine. I was so preoccupied with taking Damestier on, that I forgot to care for that Rainbow Rose at home.

240182003.text: I'm afraid that this one, too, will...

240182004.text: Don't worry, Linorea. Go and do what you must. I promise that flowers that do not wilt will always be waiting for you at home.

240182101.text: Why are you giving me Romaritime Flowers?

240182102.text: I usually send you Rainbow Roses, but I thought that we should have a change of pace today.

240182103.text: I see, is that so... Why do I feel like you're telling me to calm down?

240182104.text: That is exactly the case, dear Linorea. Could you please do so? The opera is about to begin.

240182105.text: Ah, alright, since you went to the trouble with these flowers... But you must stay with me, always. Someone has to make sure I remain calm, after all.

240182106.text: Your wish is my command, milady. Not a step away shall I take.

240182201.text: Hmph. Ah, dear, dear Semaine... A Lumidouce Bell, as a gift? Is this a threat? To break things off with me if I do not calm myself?

240182202.text: Ah, come now, I would never imply such a thing. I just wish that your heart might be freed from these frustrations as soon as possible.

240182203.text: The opera is about to begin. If your heart remains within their terrible grip, I fear we won't be able to enter the hall.

240182205.text: Alright, alright. I'll do my best to put it out of my mind.

240182206.text: Hmm... Which opera should we watch this time...

240181401.text: Traveler, thank goodness you're here. Did you get the fish fry?

240183001.text: Hah! This is exactly the perfume I need. Thank you, Semaine.

240183002.text: I shall wear this perfume to go and interview that fool Damestier. I'll corner her with ease this time, just you see!

240183003.text: Hahaha. I love it when you're so full of vigor, Linorea.

240183004.text: But before you ride off to war, let's hurry and get to the opera house first, or we'll miss the opening for sure.

240183005.text: Right you are! Let's enjoy the opera first. Then I'll collect my thoughts and crush that Damestier once and for all!

240183101.text: This perfume... Dear Semaine, are you reminding me to focus my attention on you?

240183102.text: You could focus on the opera too... I just wish you wouldn't let all the Mekafish business ruin the wonderful time we spend together.

240183201.text: The scent of algae... Heh, this certainly brings the fish tank back to mind.

240183202.text: I entrust you with everything while I go toe-to-toe with Damestier, dear Semaine.

240183203.text: To attend to your ideals is my great honor, milady.

240183204.text: *sigh* I find it hard to conceive of how a good fellow like you survives in an environment as idiotic as the Maison Gestion...

240183205.text: I have a conscience, a sense of humor, and two excellent colleagues.

240183206.text: And of course, I have you, milady, my constant companion.

240183207.text: My, what a talker! Do you speak even half this much at the Maison Gestion?

240183208.text: I barely speak at all while I'm there. Words do my work no good.

240183209.text: Alright, dear Linorea. The opera is about to begin, so let us be off.

240183210.text: As you say, my love. I shall do as you say.

240183301.text: Ah, Linorea... I fear your temper must itself be tempered...

240183303.text: You state your reasons for being here...

240183304.text: Semaine is... Well, his love for Linorea knows no worldly equal, I'll say that much.

240183305.text: Here, take these fry with you. Semaine requested that I find them... Plans to send them to her as a gift, I'll bet.

240183306.text: Alright, take the fry to Semaine, would you? I've got some other things to handle.

240181901.text: Thank you so much! This is a most lovely flower. It shall go to her right this instant!

240181902.text: Let's just watch from over here. If we get too close, things might get kinda...

240181904.text: That's right. Anyway, let's just hope Linorea does cheer up, eh?

240183408.text: That's why I asked a good friend of mine to collect some. I treated him to quite a few meals on that account.

240183409.text: But when did I... Ah! Was that the day when we went boating... But I only said it in passing...

240183410.text: Ah, don't underestimate the memory of a Gestionnaire, milady.

240183412.text: Alright. Let's admire this tank of fish fry later. For now, let us go into the opera house. The show is about to begin.

240183413.text: Ah, I daresay that we are the only ones in the Court of Fontaine who would bring a fish tank to an opera.

240183414.text: And that's a good thing. It makes us unique.

240183415.text: Indeed, my dear lady. In that case, let us be off.

240182301.text: Welcome. Are you here to purchase some perfume? We've just got some new stock.

240182303.text: Oh, you mean Ms. Linorea? She comes around often to buy "Marcotte" perfume.

240182304.text: According to her, she will only put it on when she goes out on official business.

240182305.text: If I'm not mistaken, however, Mr. Semaine, who comes with her, prefers "Lakelight."

240182307.text: Ah, yes! We did promote some "Tidalga" perfume previously. It has a unique algae scent. I do recall Ms. Linorea taking quite the interest in it.

240182308.text: Semaine has already given us the Mora beforehand, so just take your pick, and I'll hand you the perfume of your choice.

240180307.text: And she... Well, she started sulking again.

240180308.text: Not to be rude or anything, but she sure does get angry easily...

240180311.text: But she's always so mad. Do you...

240180313.text: Okay, okay, cut it out, or your smile might split your face open!

240180702.text: Curses... If only she'd reply. Then I'd have time to take care of those <color=#00E1FFFF>Rainbow Roses</color> we have at home.

240181705.text: What could I do — if not only as she asked?
